title: Gemini Embedding 2 Preview deprecated; requests route to gemini-embedding-2 from November 6, 2026
detail: The Gemini API release notes for November 6, 2026 state that gemini-embedding-2-preview is deprecated. Effective November 6, 2026, API requests to gemini-embedding-2-preview route to gemini-embedding-2 at Gemini Embedding 2 rates. Google states that gemini-embedding-2 uses the same API schema, pricing and embedding space, so no other code changes or vector re-indexing are needed.
impact: Calls to gemini-embedding-2-preview keep working but are already served by gemini-embedding-2 at the same price. Existing vectors stay compatible. Change the model string to gemini-embedding-2 so the code does not depend on the preview alias.
